claim: The sample check is isolated from saved booking-hour configuration.
sandbox: Fresh browser context with real configuration seeded before /demo; sample reset; assert real key remains unchanged.

claim: The sample check shows 18 months of booking hours in five client time zones and marks clock changes.
sandbox: Fresh ?demo=1 with fixed New York Sunday fixture; assert five zones, 18-month summary, exact shifted/skipped/repeated counts, and matching flagged entries.

claim: Export every generated bookable time as CSV.
where: Home trust line, results toolbar, and README
sandbox: Fresh /demo; download CSV and assert the filename, header, and data-row count exactly equal the generated bookable-time count.

claim: Copy a read-only weekly booking-hours check that opens with its result.
sandbox: Fresh /demo; copy the weekly review link, open it in a fresh page, and assert matching dates, zones, count, populated result, read-only form, and no calendar-file contents.

claim: The demo check runs in this browser without third-party requests.
where: Home trust line and privacy page
sandbox: Fresh /demo; capture every request during calculation and assert only the product origin occurs.

claim: The sample needs no calendar login.
sandbox: Fresh /demo; assert the visible promise and absence of credential, login, and OAuth controls.

claim: The sample check works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Fresh ?demo=1, wait for service-worker control, set browser offline, reload, and assert the sample result.

claim: Weekly booking hours stay in this browser.
sandbox: Fresh ?demo=1, choose Start for real, enter normal weekly booking hours, run the check, capture requests, and assert the documented local-storage key is the only saved configuration.

claim: Calendar-file contents stay in the open page and never enter review links.
where: Calendar import help, results note, README, and Privacy
sandbox: Fresh ?demo=1; import the fixed calendar fixture, run the check, and assert same-origin-only GET requests, no fixture text in local storage or URL, and disabled review-link export.

claim: The normal booking-hours check covers 18 months in up to five client time zones using this browser’s time-zone rules.
sandbox: Fresh /demo, choose Start for real, enter a five-zone weekly fixture, then assert the emitted 18-month range and a known New York-to-London time conversion.

claim: The check does not read your scheduler, calendar, overrides, or busy times.
sandbox: Fresh /demo, choose Start for real, run normal and calendar-file checks, and assert no provider/login controls or non-product-origin requests.

claim: Print the full booking-hours check or save it as a PDF.
sandbox: Fresh /demo with its populated result; replace window.print, activate Print or save as PDF, and assert the browser print action is called.
